ROUTE_OPTIONS.vf52Finding: C-10-CRIMINAL page 1 prints three mutually exclusive relief requests; the packet ticks none and the guide never said the choice existed, so a participant following it files an Affidavit of Substantial Hardship requesting no relief.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.whoseElectionIsIt: DECIDED FROM THE COMMITTED RECORD, and the record settles both halves separately. WHICH of the three this route concerns is settled: rules.fees reads '$500, or C-10-Criminal where indigency is claimed' and rules.feeWaiver names 'C-10-Criminal, Affidavit of Substantial Hardship and Order', and the third printed request is the one asking for waiver of the expungement petition administrative filing fee -- the only one of the three that mentions an expungement petition at all. The first asks the court to appoint an attorney and the second asks to waive ignition interlock device fees; neither appears anywhere in this route's record. WHETHER to make it is NOT the packet's: the same rule conditions the waiver on indigency being CLAIMED, and the sentence beside the box is a sworn first-person statement about the participant's own finances, which this packet does not hold and its own field map records as factAvailable false throughout the affidavit. So the election is the participant's, and the packet's job is to name the box and say what each branch means. No stop was needed on this obligation; the record settles it.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.controlToPrintedLineBinding: Verified geometrically, not from labels: Check Box2.0 y 592.20 beside the appointed-attorney line (baseline ~591.5); Check Box2.1 y 576.53 beside the ignition-interlock line (~575.9); Check Box2.2 y 554.86 beside the expungement-petition-filing-fee line (~555.3).
ROUTE_OPTIONS.repair: A new guide section, 'The relief request on C-10-CRIMINAL that this packet has not made', quotes the affidavit's own subtitle and all three printed requests verbatim, states that the packet ticks none of them on either fixture, identifies the third as the one this route concerns and why, says plainly that the election is the participant's and why the packet will not make it, and tells them what to do on each branch -- including that an affidavit filed with no box ticked asks the court for nothing. Step 5 now points at that section instead of leaving the election unmentioned. The three checkboxes are reclassified in the field map with the printed request beside each recorded verbatim; all three keep routeDetermined false. A readback, assertC10PrintedRelief, re-reads every quoted line out of the DELIVERED bytes of both fixtures on every build, so the guide cannot quote a line the affidavit does not carry.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.deliberateDivergenceFromTheSibling: al-trafficking-set TICKS C-10 Check Box2.2 and tells the participant to remove the affidavit if they are not claiming hardship. That is defensible on the same rule, and this lane does NOT report it as a defect. This family discloses instead of electing, because this family's own guide already makes filing the affidavit conditional ('If you are claiming indigency, complete the C-10-CRIMINAL affidavit included in this packet') and a packet that ticks a sworn hardship assertion beneath a guide calling the affidavit optional contradicts itself. Unlike the MUNICIPALITY OF defect, where one treatment contradicted rules.filing outright, both treatments here are consistent with the record. This is a build decision, recorded as one, and flagged for the integrator rather than resolved across families by a lane that holds only two of them.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.finalState: REPAIRED by disclosure, byte-free. Nothing was elected for the participant.
